title: Appointments
intro: Manage services, staff, availability and customer bookings.
denied: Only owners, admins and agents can access appointments.
loadError: Could not load appointments. Try again.
error: Could not save this change. Check the details and refresh availability.
zone: Filters and new slot times use your device: {device}. Appointments are shown in workspace time: {workspace}.
name: Name
templateHelp: Outside the WhatsApp reply window, a template in the customer’s language and existing opt-in are required. Variables: {{1}} service, {{2}} staff, {{3}} local time.
emptySlots: No slots in this date range. An admin can add availability.
consent: The customer agrees to receive an appointment reminder.
holdHelp: A hold is not a booking. Review it below and confirm before it expires. Recent customer conversations are listed.
emptyBookings: No bookings in this date range.
cancelPrompt: Cancel this appointment? Pending reminders will stop.
rescheduleHelp: Choose a new slot. The original booking stays until the replacement is confirmed.
reminderHelp: Reminders need consent. Web reminders appear in the open chat. Sent means accepted, not delivery proof. Unknown sends are never retried automatically.
limit: Lists show at most 100 records; choose a date range of 60 days or less.

reasons.delivery_unknown: Inspect the conversation before sending anything else

calendar.title: Google Calendar
calendar.help: Connect calendars to offer times within workspace hours. Bookings stay pending until Google confirms. Without calendar links, manual availability is used.
calendar.permissions: Google permissions: read calendar names, check busy times and create or remove appointment events. No invitations are sent.
calendar.error: Could not update calendars. Refresh and try again.
calendar.disabled: Google connection is not configured. A platform administrator must add the OAuth app credentials in environment settings. Live verification is pending.
calendar.label: Account label
calendar.attention: Calendar needs attention. Refresh the connection or disconnect and authorize it again.
calendar.disconnectConfirm: Disconnect this Google account? Linked availability will pause. Existing Google events remain; remove links to use manual slots.
calendar.bindingHelp: Select a service, a staff member, or both. Up to five calendar links are supported. All matching calendars must be free. Availability refreshes every minute and pauses if stale.
calendar.consent: I authorize sharing the customer name, phone number and conversation link in appointment events on this calendar.
calendar.noBindings: No calendar links. Manual availability is active.
calendar.unlinkConfirm: Remove this calendar link? New reservations use the remaining links or manual slots. Existing bookings keep their calendar events.
